resolution.note: drift check reports missing skills paths and off-advisory relay thresholds; fixture tests pass

title: Drift check flags adopted-repo prompts naming removed skill scripts or stale context thresholds
body:
Agent prompts and AGENTS.md in adopted repositories kept telling leads to measure context with `context-usage.py` (removed from the context-relay skill) and to report a "hook 150k vs relay 200k" conflict that krn #1212 resolved on 2026-11-16; about 15 files across projects carried it for days (operator found it in sawaryn-i-partnerzy, 2026-11-17).
Outcome: `krn adopt drift` (or the existing drift check) reports, per adopted repository, agent-facing markdown (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/*PROMPT*.md) that names a script path of a global or KRN skill which no longer exists, and a stated context threshold that differs from the gauge advisories of the configured window.
Proof: node --test test/adopt/drift.test.ts exits 0 with a fixture repo naming context-usage.py and a 150k relay threshold
